                                    "series_id": m["series_id"], "vintage_id": m["vintage_id"],
                                    "fy": m["fy"], "chapter": "Table", "table_ordinal": 1}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [], "min_files_required": 1,
            "note": m["note"]})

    # ---- canonical_duplicate ----------------------------------------------
    for i, d in enumerate(dupes[:QUESTION_COUNTS["canonical_duplicate"]]):
        sid = d["series_id"]
        s = series[sid]
        cur = [c for c in d["copies"] if c["current"]][0]
        stale = [c for c in d["copies"] if not c["current"]]
        v = vmap[cur["vintage_id"]]
        fys = sorted(v["values"])
        fy = fys[-1] if fys else world["fy"][-1]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"cd_{i:02d}", "type": "canonical_duplicate",
            "question": (f"there are a few copies of the {s['label'].lower()} series lying "
                         f"around - which one is current, and what does it say for {fy}"),
            "expected_answer": {"path": cur["path"], "value": v["values"].get(fy),
                                "unit": v["unit"], "fy": fy, "vintage_id": cur["vintage_id"],
                                "series_id": sid},
            "evidence_addresses": [{"path": cur["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                                    "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                                    "row": v["row_label"], "col": fy, "series_id": sid,
                                    "vintage_id": cur["vintage_id"], "fy": fy,
                                    "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [],
            "must_not_cite": [{"path": c["path"], "kind": "stale_copy", "shadows_q": f"cd_{i:02d}",
                               "shadows_path": cur["path"], "series_id": sid,
                               "why_wrong": (f"Holds the vintage published in {c['pub_year']}; "
                                             f"superseded by the copy at {cur['path']}.")}
                              for c in stale],
            "min_files_required": 1})

    # ---- reconciliation ----------------------------------------------------
    recon_pairs = []
    for path, meta in answer_data.items():
        sid = meta["series_id"]
        docs = [d for d in world["catalogue"]
                if any(e["series_id"] == sid for e in d["embeds"])]
        if not docs:
            continue
        g = rng("recon", path)
        d = docs[int(g.integers(0, len(docs)))]
        e = [x for x in d["embeds"] if x["series_id"] == sid][0]
        if e["vintage_id"] == meta["vintage_id"]:
            olds = [v for v in vints[sid] if v["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]]
            if not olds:
                continue
            alt = [dd for dd in docs
                   if any(x["series_id"] == sid and x["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]
                          for x in dd["embeds"])]
            if not alt:
                continue
            d = alt[0]
            e = [x for x in d["embeds"]
                 if x["series_id"] == sid and x["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]][0]
        recon_pairs.append((path, meta, d, e))
    for i, (path, meta, d, e) in enumerate(recon_pairs[:QUESTION_COUNTS["reconciliation"]]):
        sid = meta["series_id"]
        s = series[sid]
        vc, vp = vmap[meta["vintage_id"]], vmap[e["vintage_id"]]
        common = sorted(set(vc["values"]) & set(vp["values"]))
        if not common:
            continue
        fy = common[-1]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"rc_{i:02d}", "type": "reconciliation",
            "question": (f"the spreadsheet and the published document give different numbers "
                         f"for {s['label'].lower()} in {fy} - which is right"),
            "expected_answer": {
                "resolution": "both are correct for their own vintage",
                "csv": {"path": path, "value": vc["values"][fy], "unit": vc["unit"],
                        "vintage_id": vc["vintage_id"],
                        "published": vc["published_in"]["year"], "row_label": vc["row_label"]},
                "pdf": {"path": placed_docs[d["doc_id"]]["path"], "value": vp["values"][fy],
                        "unit": vp["unit"], "vintage_id": vp["vintage_id"],
                        "published": vp["published_in"]["year"], "row_label": vp["row_label"]},
                "reason": (f"The two figures are different vintages of {s['label']}: the "
                           f"{vp['published_in']['year']} publication and the "
                           f"{vc['published_in']['year']} revision. Any statement has to name "
                           f"which one it is using."),
                "fy": fy, "series_id": sid},
            "evidence_addresses": [
                {"path": path, "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None, "page_index": None,
                 "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": vc["row_label"], "col": fy,
                 "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": vc["vintage_id"], "fy": fy,
                 "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None},
                addr_for(placed_docs, d["doc_id"], e, fy, vmap)],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [], "min_files_required": 2})

    # ---- stale_doc ---------------------------------------------------------
    stale_docs = [s for s in sediment
                  if s["truth_status"] in ("stale_describes_restructured_folder",
                                           "contradicts_sibling",
                                           "agent_generated_never_updated",
                                           "abandoned_midway")]
    true_docs = [s for s in sediment if s["truth_status"] in ("current",
                                                              "handoff_from_departed_person")]
    STALE_Q = [
        "where does the cleaned household survey extract actually live",
        "what is the status of the collection script - is it finished",
        "which folder holds the current cleaned data",
        "is the reorganisation finished or not",
        "where should new source documents be filed",
        "what is left to do on the provincial extraction",
        "which of these two locations is the live one for cleaned data",
        "did the provincial consolidation actually reconcile",
        "what is blocking the source selection",
        "is the replication package complete",
        "which document is the reference for Balochistan",
        "what happened to the KP white papers",
        "is the deflator question settled",
        "where are the manually typed tables",
        "what is the current column naming convention here",
    ]
    for i in range(QUESTION_COUNTS["stale_doc"]):
        if not true_docs or not stale_docs:
            break
        t = true_docs[i % len(true_docs)]
        sd = stale_docs[i % len(stale_docs)]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"sd_{i:02d}", "type": "stale_doc",
            "question": STALE_Q[i % len(STALE_Q)],
            "expected_answer": {"authoritative_path": t["path"],
                                "truth_status": t["truth_status"],
                                "note": ("The document that is right about its own folder is the "
                                         "deeper one; the shallower document was written before "
                                         "the folder changed and was never revised.")},
            "evidence_addresses": [{"path": t["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                                    "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                                    "row": None, "col": None, "series_id": None,
                                    "vintage_id": None, "fy": None, "chapter": None,
                                    "table_ordinal": None}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [],
            "must_not_cite": [{"path": sd["path"], "kind": "stale_document",
                               "shadows_q": f"sd_{i:02d}", "shadows_path": t["path"],
                               "series_id": None,
                               "why_wrong": (f"Marked {sd['truth_status']}: it describes a state "
                                             f"of the folder that no longer holds, and nothing "
                                             f"in it says so.")}],
            "min_files_required": 1})

    # ---- relationship ------------------------------------------------------
    for i, link in enumerate(relationship_links[:QUESTION_COUNTS["relationship"]]):
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"rl_{i:02d}", "type": "relationship",
            "question": link["question"],
            "expected_answer": link["expected"],
            "evidence_addresses": link["evidence"],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [],
            "min_files_required": len(link["evidence"])})
    return questions


def addr_for(placed_docs, doc_id, emb, fy, vmap):
    v = vmap[emb["vintage_id"]]
    return {"path": placed_docs[doc_id]["path"], "doc_id": doc_id, "content_hash": None,
            "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
            "row": v["row_label"], "col": fy, "chapter": emb["chapter"],
            "table_ordinal": emb["table_ordinal"], "series_id": emb["series_id"],
            "vintage_id": emb["vintage_id"], "fy": fy}


# ==========================================================================
# Phase 3h -- link files (memo -> page, codebook -> column, do-file -> input)
# ==========================================================================
def place_links(plan: Plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data, sediment) -> list[dict]:
    """Files that only make sense in pairs. The question can only be settled by
    following the link."""
    links = []
    series = world["series"]
    vints = _vints(world)

    # (a) memos citing a table by page -- the citation tokens in the authored memos
    for s in sediment:
        for tok in s["citation_tokens"]:
            doc_id, _, sid = tok.partition(":")

                "question": (f"the memo mentions {series[sid]['label'].lower()} and points at a "
                             f"table - what is the number it is pointing at"),
                "expected": {"series_id": sid, "cited_in": s["path"], "doc_id": doc_id,
                             "resolve_from": "pdf_index sidecar of the cited document"},
                "evidence": [
                    {"path": s["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None, "page_index": None,
                     "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": None, "col": None,
                     "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": None, "fy": None, "chapter": None,
                     "table_ordinal": None},
                    {"path": placed_docs[doc_id]["path"], "doc_id": doc_id, "content_hash": None,
                     "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": None,
                     "col": None, "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": None, "fy": None,
                     "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}]})

    # (b) a do-file that names its input, and the input
    do_specs = [
        ("RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/scripts", "01_build_panel.do",
         "RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/clean/provincial_outlay_long.csv", True),
        ("RA Work/adp_execution/scripts", "02_execution_ratios.R",
         "RA Work/adp_execution/clean/adp_execution_panel.csv", True),
        ("RA Work/tax_effort/scripts", "03_tax_effort.do",

# ==========================================================================
# Phase 5 planning -- agent layer, sediment volume, filler
# ==========================================================================
AGENT_FILES = [
    ("agent_workspace/.claude", "settings.local.json", "json", "claude_settings"),
    ("agent_workspace/.claude/commands", "extract.md", "md", "claude_command"),
    ("agent_workspace/.claude/commands", "reconcile.md", "md", "claude_command"),
    ("agent_workspace/scripts", "run_ingest.py", "txt", "pipeline_script"),
    ("agent_workspace/plans", "PLAN.md", "md", "agent_plan"),
]


def plan_agent_layer(plan: Plan, world, n_json: int) -> int:
    """Agent-era run logs, extraction outputs, transcripts and settings."""
    placed = 0
    for dirpath, fname, fmt, kind in AGENT_FILES:
        if dirpath not in plan.by_path:
            continue
        plan.place(dirpath, fname, role="agent", fmt=fmt,
                   owner="agent", era="agent", doc_id=f"ag::{dirpath}/{fname}",
                   spec={"kind": kind, "era": "agent"})
        placed += 1
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["branch"] == "agent" and d["kind"] != "empty"]
    cat = [d for d in world["catalogue"]]
    i = 0
    while placed < n_json:
        g = rng("agentjson", i)
        d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
        doc = cat[int(g.integers(0, len(cat)))]
        kind = ["extraction_output", "run_log", "tool_transcript", "reconcile_report"][i % 4]
        stem = SK._slug(doc["doc_id"], "_")
        fname = {"extraction_output": f"{stem}_extracted.json",
                 "run_log": f"run_{2024 + i % 3}{(i % 12) + 1:02d}{(i % 27) + 1:02d}_{i:04d}.json",
                 "tool_transcript": f"transcript_{i:04d}.json",
                 "reconcile_report": f"{stem}_reconcile.json"}[kind]
        plan.place(d["path"], fname, role="agent", fmt="json", owner="agent", era="agent",
                   doc_id=f"ag::{i}", spec={"kind": kind, "doc_id": doc["doc_id"],
                                            "doc_title": doc["title"], "era": "agent"})
        placed += 1
        i += 1
        if i > n_json * 4:
            break
    return placed


def plan_sediment_volume(plan: Plan, world, n_md: int, sediment: list) -> int:
    """Mutated copies of the authored documents, spread across the tree."""
    man = json.loads((ROOT / "seed_docs" / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["kind"] not in ("empty",) and plan.room(d)]
    made, i = 0, 0
    mutations = ["shift_dates", "swap_folder_names", "splice_paragraphs", "drop_sections",
                 "change_subfolder_list", "shorten", "retitle", "merge_two"]
    while made < n_md and i < n_md * 6:
        g = rng("sedvol", i)
        i += 1
        d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
        if not plan.room(d):
            continue
        m = man[int(g.integers(0, len(man)))]
        mut = mutations[int(g.integers(0, len(mutations)))]
        base = m["target_filename"][:-3]
        era = d["era"]
        conv = d["convention"]
        stem = SK.apply_convention(base, era, conv, g)
        plan.place(d["path"], f"{stem}.md", role="sediment", fmt="md", owner="sediment",
                   era=era, doc_id=f"sedv::{i}",
                   spec={"kind": "authored", "source_id": m["id"],
                         "source_file": m["source_file"], "mutation": mut,
                         "truth_status": m["truth_status"], "voice": m["voice"],
                         "citation_tokens": []})
        made += 1
    return made


FILLER_PDF_KINDS = ["journal_article", "working_paper", "report", "lecture_slides",
                    "old_survey_chapter", "conference_paper", "thesis_chapter", "scanned_note"]
FILLER_DATA_KINDS = ["wdi_wide", "weo_extract", "pbs_table", "sbp_easydata", "hies_extract",
                     "panel_country_year", "regression_output", "raw_beside_clean",
                     "problem_set_data", "grade_sheet"]


def plan_filler(plan: Plan, world, targets: dict) -> dict:
    """Fill the remainder so the whole tree hits the configured format mix."""
    made = Counter()
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["kind"] != "empty"]
    era_pool = []
    for e, w in ERA_W.items():
        era_pool += [e] * int(round(w * 100))
    i = 0
    order = []
    for fmt, n in targets.items():
        order += [fmt] * n
    g0 = W.rng_for("fillorder")
    g0.shuffle(order)
    for fmt in order:
        for _attempt in range(40):
            i += 1
            g = rng("fill", i)
            d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
            if not plan.room(d):
                continue
            era = d["era"]
            conv = d["convention"]
            if fmt == "pdf":
                kind = FILLER_PDF_KINDS[int(g.integers(0, len(FILLER_PDF_KINDS)))]
                paper = world["entities"]["papers"][int(g.integers(0, 200))]
                base = paper["title"][:60]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(base, era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_doc", "filler_kind": kind, "title": paper["title"],
                        "authors": paper["authors"], "year": paper["year"],
                        "journal": paper["journal"], "era": era,
                        "target_pages": int(g.integers(*CFG["normal_pdf_pages"])),
                        "fat": False, "scanned": kind == "scanned_note",
                        "series_id": sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]}
                owner = "pdf"
            elif fmt == "csv":
                kind = FILLER_DATA_KINDS[int(g.integers(0, len(FILLER_DATA_KINDS)))]
                sid = sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"{kind} {sid}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_data", "data_kind": kind, "series_id": sid, "era": era}
                owner = "data"
            elif fmt == "md":
                stem = SK.apply_convention(
                    ["notes", "readme", "todo", "log", "summary", "outline",
                     "reading list", "comments"][int(g.integers(0, 8))], era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_note", "era": era}
                owner = "sediment"
            elif fmt == "json":
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"output {i}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_json", "era": era}
                owner = "agent"
            else:
                sid = sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"{fmt} {sid}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_tail", "tail_format": fmt, "series_id": sid, "era": era}
                owner = "tail" if fmt in ("docx", "zip", "txt") else "data"
            plan.place(d["path"], f"{stem}.{fmt}", role="filler", fmt=fmt, owner=owner,
                       era=era, doc_id=f"fl::{i}", spec=spec)
            made[fmt] += 1
            break
    return made


# ==========================================================================
# main
# ==========================================================================
def main():
    world = W.load()
    dirs = SK.assign_capacity(SK.build_dirs(), TOTAL)
    plan = Plan(dirs)

    placed_docs = place_catalogue(plan, world)
    answer_data = place_answer_data(plan, world)
    misnamed = place_misnamed(plan, world)
    dupes = place_duplicates(plan, world)
    sediment = place_sediment_anchors(plan, world)
    questions = build_questions(plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data)
    links = place_links(plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data, sediment)
    questions = build_questions_2(plan, world, questions, placed_docs, answer_data,
                                  misnamed, dupes, sediment, links)

    lo, hi = CFG["distractors_per_answer"]
    dx = DX.derive(plan, world, questions, placed_docs, lo, hi)

    # ---- how much is left, and in what format ----------------------------
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)
    want = {"pdf": int(TOTAL * MIX["pdf"]), "csv": int(TOTAL * MIX["csv"]),
            "md": int(TOTAL * MIX["md"]), "json": int(TOTAL * MIX["json_agent"])}
    tail_total = int(TOTAL * MIX["tail"])

    n_json = max(0, want["json"] - have["json"])
    plan_agent_layer(plan, world, n_json)
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)

    n_md_sed = max(0, int((want["md"] - have["md"]) * 0.62))
    plan_sediment_volume(plan, world, n_md_sed, sediment)
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)

    targets = {"pdf": max(0, want["pdf"] - have["pdf"]),
               "csv": max(0, want["csv"] - have["csv"]),
               "md": max(0, want["md"] - have["md"]),
               "json": max(0, want["json"] - have["json"])}
    tail_have = sum(have[f] for f in TAIL_FORMATS)
    per_tail = max(0, tail_total - tail_have)
    tw = {"dta": 0.17, "do": 0.17, "R": 0.14, "xlsx": 0.16, "docx": 0.13, "txt": 0.13, "log": 0.10}
    for f, w in tw.items():
        targets[f] = int(per_tail * w)
    plan_filler(plan, world, targets)

    # ---- write the plan and the key --------------------------------------
    KEYS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (KEYS / "skeleton_manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"dirs": dirs, "files": plan.files}, indent=None), encoding="utf-8")
    (KEYS / "placed_catalogue.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({k: v["path"] for k, v in placed_docs.items()}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    key = {
        "built_from_seed": CFG["seed"],
        "ladder": CFG["ladder"],
        "questions": questions,
        "answer_files": {f["path"]: {"role": f["role"], "doc_id": f.get("doc_id"),
                                     "fmt": f["fmt"]}
                         for f in plan.files if f["role"] == "answer"},
        "distractor_files": {d["path"]: d for d in dx},
        "duplicate_clusters": dupes,
        "misnamed_files": misnamed,
        "sediment_anchors": sediment,
        "relationship_links": links,
    }
    (KEYS / "answer_key.json").write_text(json.dumps(key, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")

    fmt_counts = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)
    role_counts = Counter(f["role"] for f in plan.files)
    print(f"files planned    : {len(plan.files)}  (target {TOTAL})")
    print(f"by role          : {dict(role_counts)}")
    print(f"by format        : {dict(fmt_counts)}")
    print(f"questions        : {len(questions)} {dict(Counter(q['type'] for q in questions))}")
    print(f"distractors       : {len(dx)}")
    print(f"dirs used        : {len([d for d in dirs if plan.used[d['path']]])}/{len(dirs)}")
    print(f"empty dirs       : {len([d for d in dirs if not plan.used[d['path']]])}")
    print(f"max depth        : {max(f['depth'] for f in plan.files)}")
    return plan


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                                "vintage_id": m["vintage_id"]},
            "evidence_addresses": [{"path": m["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                                    "page_index": None, "page_label": None,
                                    "table_title": None, "row": v["row_label"], "col": m["fy"],
                                    "series_id": m["series_id"], "vintage_id": m["vintage_id"],
                                    "fy": m["fy"], "chapter": "Table", "table_ordinal": 1}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [], "min_files_required": 1,
            "note": m["note"]})

    # ---- canonical_duplicate ----------------------------------------------
    for i, d in enumerate(dupes[:QUESTION_COUNTS["canonical_duplicate"]]):
        sid = d["series_id"]
        s = series[sid]
        cur = [c for c in d["copies"] if c["current"]][0]
        stale = [c for c in d["copies"] if not c["current"]]
        v = vmap[cur["vintage_id"]]
        fys = sorted(v["values"])
        fy = fys[-1] if fys else world["fy"][-1]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"cd_{i:02d}", "type": "canonical_duplicate",
            "question": (f"there are a few copies of the {s['label'].lower()} series lying "
                         f"around - which one is current, and what does it say for {fy}"),
            "expected_answer": {"path": cur["path"], "value": v["values"].get(fy),
                                "unit": v["unit"], "fy": fy, "vintage_id": cur["vintage_id"],
                                "series_id": sid},
            "evidence_addresses": [{"path": cur["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                                    "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                                    "row": v["row_label"], "col": fy, "series_id": sid,
                                    "vintage_id": cur["vintage_id"], "fy": fy,
                                    "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [],
            "must_not_cite": [{"path": c["path"], "kind": "stale_copy", "shadows_q": f"cd_{i:02d}",
                               "shadows_path": cur["path"], "series_id": sid,
                               "why_wrong": (f"Holds the vintage published in {c['pub_year']}; "
                                             f"superseded by the copy at {cur['path']}.")}
                              for c in stale],
            "min_files_required": 1})

    # ---- reconciliation ----------------------------------------------------
    recon_pairs = []
    for path, meta in answer_data.items():
        sid = meta["series_id"]
        docs = [d for d in world["catalogue"]
                if any(e["series_id"] == sid for e in d["embeds"])]
        if not docs:
            continue
        g = rng("recon", path)
        d = docs[int(g.integers(0, len(docs)))]
        e = [x for x in d["embeds"] if x["series_id"] == sid][0]
        if e["vintage_id"] == meta["vintage_id"]:
            olds = [v for v in vints[sid] if v["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]]
            if not olds:
                continue
            alt = [dd for dd in docs
                   if any(x["series_id"] == sid and x["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]
                          for x in dd["embeds"])]
            if not alt:
                continue
            d = alt[0]
            e = [x for x in d["embeds"]
                 if x["series_id"] == sid and x["vintage_id"] != meta["vintage_id"]][0]
        recon_pairs.append((path, meta, d, e))
    for i, (path, meta, d, e) in enumerate(recon_pairs[:QUESTION_COUNTS["reconciliation"]]):
        sid = meta["series_id"]
        s = series[sid]
        vc, vp = vmap[meta["vintage_id"]], vmap[e["vintage_id"]]
        common = sorted(set(vc["values"]) & set(vp["values"]))
        if not common:
            continue
        fy = common[-1]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"rc_{i:02d}", "type": "reconciliation",
            "question": (f"the spreadsheet and the published document give different numbers "
                         f"for {s['label'].lower()} in {fy} - which is right"),
            "expected_answer": {
                "resolution": "both are correct for their own vintage",
                "csv": {"path": path, "value": vc["values"][fy], "unit": vc["unit"],
                        "vintage_id": vc["vintage_id"],
                        "published": vc["published_in"]["year"], "row_label": vc["row_label"]},
                "pdf": {"path": placed_docs[d["doc_id"]]["path"], "value": vp["values"][fy],
                        "unit": vp["unit"], "vintage_id": vp["vintage_id"],
                        "published": vp["published_in"]["year"], "row_label": vp["row_label"]},
                "reason": (f"The two figures are different vintages of {s['label']}: the "
                           f"{vp['published_in']['year']} publication and the "
                           f"{vc['published_in']['year']} revision. Any statement has to name "
                           f"which one it is using."),
                "fy": fy, "series_id": sid},
            "evidence_addresses": [
                {"path": path, "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None, "page_index": None,
                 "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": vc["row_label"], "col": fy,
                 "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": vc["vintage_id"], "fy": fy,
                 "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None},
                addr_for(placed_docs, d["doc_id"], e, fy, vmap)],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [], "min_files_required": 2})

    # ---- stale_doc ---------------------------------------------------------
    stale_docs = [s for s in sediment
                  if s["truth_status"] in ("stale_describes_restructured_folder",
                                           "contradicts_sibling",
                                           "agent_generated_never_updated",
                                           "abandoned_midway")]
    true_docs = [s for s in sediment if s["truth_status"] in ("current",
                                                              "handoff_from_departed_person")]
    STALE_Q = [
        "where does the cleaned household survey extract actually live",
        "what is the status of the collection script - is it finished",
        "which folder holds the current cleaned data",
        "is the reorganisation finished or not",
        "where should new source documents be filed",
        "what is left to do on the provincial extraction",
        "which of these two locations is the live one for cleaned data",
        "did the provincial consolidation actually reconcile",
        "what is blocking the source selection",
        "is the replication package complete",
        "which document is the reference for Balochistan",
        "what happened to the KP white papers",
        "is the deflator question settled",
        "where are the manually typed tables",
        "what is the current column naming convention here",
    ]
    for i in range(QUESTION_COUNTS["stale_doc"]):
        if not true_docs or not stale_docs:
            break
        t = true_docs[i % len(true_docs)]
        sd = stale_docs[i % len(stale_docs)]
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"sd_{i:02d}", "type": "stale_doc",
            "question": STALE_Q[i % len(STALE_Q)],
            "expected_answer": {"authoritative_path": t["path"],
                                "truth_status": t["truth_status"],
                                "note": ("The document that is right about its own folder is the "
                                         "deeper one; the shallower document was written before "
                                         "the folder changed and was never revised.")},
            "evidence_addresses": [{"path": t["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                                    "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                                    "row": None, "col": None, "series_id": None,
                                    "vintage_id": None, "fy": None, "chapter": None,
                                    "table_ordinal": None}],
            "acceptable_alternates": [],
            "must_not_cite": [{"path": sd["path"], "kind": "stale_document",
                               "shadows_q": f"sd_{i:02d}", "shadows_path": t["path"],
                               "series_id": None,
                               "why_wrong": (f"Marked {sd['truth_status']}: it describes a state "
                                             f"of the folder that no longer holds, and nothing "
                                             f"in it says so.")}],
            "min_files_required": 1})

    # ---- relationship ------------------------------------------------------
    for i, link in enumerate(relationship_links[:QUESTION_COUNTS["relationship"]]):
        questions.append({
            "q_id": f"rl_{i:02d}", "type": "relationship",
            "question": link["question"],
            "expected_answer": link["expected"],
            "evidence_addresses": link["evidence"],
            "acceptable_alternates": [], "must_not_cite": [],
            "min_files_required": len(link["evidence"])})
    return questions


def addr_for(placed_docs, doc_id, emb, fy, vmap):
    v = vmap[emb["vintage_id"]]
    return {"path": placed_docs[doc_id]["path"], "doc_id": doc_id, "content_hash": None,
            "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
            "row": v["row_label"], "col": fy, "chapter": emb["chapter"],
            "table_ordinal": emb["table_ordinal"], "series_id": emb["series_id"],
            "vintage_id": emb["vintage_id"], "fy": fy}

def place_links(plan: Plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data, sediment) -> list[dict]:
    """Files that only make sense in pairs. The question can only be settled by
    following the link."""
    links = []
    series = world["series"]
    vints = _vints(world)

    # (a) memos citing a table by page -- the citation tokens in the authored memos
    for s in sediment:
        for tok in s["citation_tokens"]:
            doc_id, _, sid = tok.partition(":")
            if doc_id not in placed_docs or sid not in series:
                continue
            links.append({
                "kind": "memo_cites_page",
                "question": (f"the memo mentions {series[sid]['label'].lower()} and points at a "
                             f"table - what is the number it is pointing at"),
                "expected": {"series_id": sid, "cited_in": s["path"], "doc_id": doc_id,
                             "resolve_from": "pdf_index sidecar of the cited document"},
                "evidence": [
                    {"path": s["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None, "page_index": None,
                     "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": None, "col": None,
                     "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": None, "fy": None, "chapter": None,
                     "table_ordinal": None},
                    {"path": placed_docs[doc_id]["path"], "doc_id": doc_id, "content_hash": None,
                     "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None, "row": None,
                     "col": None, "series_id": sid, "vintage_id": None, "fy": None,
                     "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}]})

    # (b) a do-file that names its input, and the input
    do_specs = [
        ("RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/scripts", "01_build_panel.do",
         "RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/clean/provincial_outlay_long.csv", True),
        ("RA Work/adp_execution/scripts", "02_execution_ratios.R",
         "RA Work/adp_execution/clean/adp_execution_panel.csv", True),
        ("RA Work/tax_effort/scripts", "03_tax_effort.do",
         "RA Work/tax_effort/clean/federal_tax_heads_long.csv", True),
        ("RA Work/debt_sustainability/scripts", "04_debt_paths.R",
         "RA Work/debt_sustainability/clean/debt_stock_long.csv", True),
        ("Papers/Fiscal decentralisation/code", "00_master.do",
         "Papers/Fiscal decentralisation/replication/data/raw/panel_input.csv", False),
    ]
    for dirpath, fname, target, exists in do_specs:
        if dirpath not in plan.by_path:
            continue
        fmt = "do" if fname.endswith(".do") else "R"
        rec = plan.place(dirpath, fname, role="answer", fmt=fmt, owner="data",
                         doc_id=f"link::{dirpath}/{fname}",
                         spec={"kind": "script", "language": fmt, "input_path": target,
                               "input_exists": exists, "era": plan.by_path[dirpath]["era"]})
        links.append({
            "kind": "script_names_input",
            "question": (f"what does {fname} actually read, and does that file still exist"),
            "expected": {"script": rec["path"], "input_path": target, "input_exists": exists},
            "evidence": [{"path": rec["path"], "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                          "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                          "row": None, "col": None, "series_id": None, "vintage_id": None,
                          "fy": None, "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}]
                        + ([{"path": target, "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                             "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                             "row": None, "col": None, "series_id": None, "vintage_id": None,
                             "fy": None, "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}]
                           if exists else [])})

    # (c) a codebook that explains a column nothing else explains
    for dirpath, cb, target, col in [
        ("RA Work/household_survey_extract/clean", "CODEBOOK.md",
         "RA Work/household_survey_extract/clean/hies_extract.csv", "cons_month_hh"),
        ("RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/clean", "CODEBOOK.md",
         "RA Work/provincial_fiscal_panel/clean/provincial_outlay_long.csv", "vintage_label"),
    ]:
        links.append({
            "kind": "codebook_explains_column",
            "question": f"what exactly is the {col} column in the cleaned extract",
            "expected": {"column": col, "explained_in": f"{dirpath}/{cb}", "data_file": target},
            "evidence": [{"path": f"{dirpath}/{cb}", "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                          "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                          "row": None, "col": col, "series_id": None, "vintage_id": None,
                          "fy": None, "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None},
                         {"path": target, "doc_id": None, "content_hash": None,
                          "page_index": None, "page_label": None, "table_title": None,
                          "row": None, "col": col, "series_id": None, "vintage_id": None,
                          "fy": None, "chapter": None, "table_ordinal": None}]})
    return links

AGENT_FILES = [
    ("agent_workspace/.claude", "settings.local.json", "json", "claude_settings"),
    ("agent_workspace/.claude/commands", "extract.md", "md", "claude_command"),
    ("agent_workspace/.claude/commands", "reconcile.md", "md", "claude_command"),
    ("agent_workspace/scripts", "run_ingest.py", "txt", "pipeline_script"),
    ("agent_workspace/plans", "PLAN.md", "md", "agent_plan"),
]


def plan_agent_layer(plan: Plan, world, n_json: int) -> int:
    """Agent-era run logs, extraction outputs, transcripts and settings."""
    placed = 0
    for dirpath, fname, fmt, kind in AGENT_FILES:
        if dirpath not in plan.by_path:
            continue
        plan.place(dirpath, fname, role="agent", fmt=fmt,
                   owner="agent", era="agent", doc_id=f"ag::{dirpath}/{fname}",
                   spec={"kind": kind, "era": "agent"})
        placed += 1
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["branch"] == "agent" and d["kind"] != "empty"]
    cat = [d for d in world["catalogue"]]
    i = 0
    while placed < n_json:
        g = rng("agentjson", i)
        d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
        doc = cat[int(g.integers(0, len(cat)))]
        kind = ["extraction_output", "run_log", "tool_transcript", "reconcile_report"][i % 4]
        stem = SK._slug(doc["doc_id"], "_")
        fname = {"extraction_output": f"{stem}_extracted.json",
                 "run_log": f"run_{2024 + i % 3}{(i % 12) + 1:02d}{(i % 27) + 1:02d}_{i:04d}.json",
                 "tool_transcript": f"transcript_{i:04d}.json",
                 "reconcile_report": f"{stem}_reconcile.json"}[kind]
        plan.place(d["path"], fname, role="agent", fmt="json", owner="agent", era="agent",
                   doc_id=f"ag::{i}", spec={"kind": kind, "doc_id": doc["doc_id"],
                                            "doc_title": doc["title"], "era": "agent"})
        placed += 1
        i += 1
        if i > n_json * 4:
            break
    return placed


def plan_sediment_volume(plan: Plan, world, n_md: int, sediment: list) -> int:
    """Mutated copies of the authored documents, spread across the tree."""
    man = json.loads((ROOT / "seed_docs" / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["kind"] not in ("empty",) and plan.room(d)]
    made, i = 0, 0
    mutations = ["shift_dates", "swap_folder_names", "splice_paragraphs", "drop_sections",
                 "change_subfolder_list", "shorten", "retitle", "merge_two"]
    while made < n_md and i < n_md * 6:
        g = rng("sedvol", i)
        i += 1
        d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
        if not plan.room(d):
            continue
        m = man[int(g.integers(0, len(man)))]
        mut = mutations[int(g.integers(0, len(mutations)))]
        base = m["target_filename"][:-3]
        era = d["era"]
        conv = d["convention"]
        stem = SK.apply_convention(base, era, conv, g)
        plan.place(d["path"], f"{stem}.md", role="sediment", fmt="md", owner="sediment",
                   era=era, doc_id=f"sedv::{i}",
                   spec={"kind": "authored", "source_id": m["id"],
                         "source_file": m["source_file"], "mutation": mut,
                         "truth_status": m["truth_status"], "voice": m["voice"],
                         "citation_tokens": []})
        made += 1
    return made


FILLER_PDF_KINDS = ["journal_article", "working_paper", "report", "lecture_slides",
                    "old_survey_chapter", "conference_paper", "thesis_chapter", "scanned_note"]
FILLER_DATA_KINDS = ["wdi_wide", "weo_extract", "pbs_table", "sbp_easydata", "hies_extract",
                     "panel_country_year", "regression_output", "raw_beside_clean",
                     "problem_set_data", "grade_sheet"]


def plan_filler(plan: Plan, world, targets: dict) -> dict:
    """Fill the remainder so the whole tree hits the configured format mix."""
    made = Counter()
    homes = [d for d in plan.dirs if d["kind"] != "empty"]
    era_pool = []
    for e, w in ERA_W.items():
        era_pool += [e] * int(round(w * 100))
    i = 0
    order = []
    for fmt, n in targets.items():
        order += [fmt] * n
    g0 = W.rng_for("fillorder")
    g0.shuffle(order)
    for fmt in order:
        for _attempt in range(40):
            i += 1
            g = rng("fill", i)
            d = homes[int(g.integers(0, len(homes)))]
            if not plan.room(d):
                continue
            era = d["era"]
            conv = d["convention"]
            if fmt == "pdf":
                kind = FILLER_PDF_KINDS[int(g.integers(0, len(FILLER_PDF_KINDS)))]
                paper = world["entities"]["papers"][int(g.integers(0, 200))]
                base = paper["title"][:60]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(base, era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_doc", "filler_kind": kind, "title": paper["title"],
                        "authors": paper["authors"], "year": paper["year"],
                        "journal": paper["journal"], "era": era,
                        "target_pages": int(g.integers(*CFG["normal_pdf_pages"])),
                        "fat": False, "scanned": kind == "scanned_note",
                        "series_id": sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]}
                owner = "pdf"
            elif fmt == "csv":
                kind = FILLER_DATA_KINDS[int(g.integers(0, len(FILLER_DATA_KINDS)))]
                sid = sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"{kind} {sid}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_data", "data_kind": kind, "series_id": sid, "era": era}
                owner = "data"
            elif fmt == "md":
                stem = SK.apply_convention(
                    ["notes", "readme", "todo", "log", "summary", "outline",
                     "reading list", "comments"][int(g.integers(0, 8))], era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_note", "era": era}
                owner = "sediment"
            elif fmt == "json":
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"output {i}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_json", "era": era}
                owner = "agent"
            else:
                sid = sorted(world["series"])[int(g.integers(0, 86))]
                stem = SK.apply_convention(f"{fmt} {sid}", era, conv, g)
                spec = {"kind": "filler_tail", "tail_format": fmt, "series_id": sid, "era": era}
                owner = "tail" if fmt in ("docx", "zip", "txt") else "data"
            plan.place(d["path"], f"{stem}.{fmt}", role="filler", fmt=fmt, owner=owner,
                       era=era, doc_id=f"fl::{i}", spec=spec)
            made[fmt] += 1
            break
    return made

def main():
    world = W.load()
    dirs = SK.assign_capacity(SK.build_dirs(), TOTAL)
    plan = Plan(dirs)

    placed_docs = place_catalogue(plan, world)
    answer_data = place_answer_data(plan, world)
    misnamed = place_misnamed(plan, world)
    dupes = place_duplicates(plan, world)
    sediment = place_sediment_anchors(plan, world)
    questions = build_questions(plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data)
    links = place_links(plan, world, placed_docs, answer_data, sediment)
    questions = build_questions_2(plan, world, questions, placed_docs, answer_data,
                                  misnamed, dupes, sediment, links)

    lo, hi = CFG["distractors_per_answer"]
    dx = DX.derive(plan, world, questions, placed_docs, lo, hi)

    # ---- how much is left, and in what format ----------------------------
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)
    want = {"pdf": int(TOTAL * MIX["pdf"]), "csv": int(TOTAL * MIX["csv"]),
            "md": int(TOTAL * MIX["md"]), "json": int(TOTAL * MIX["json_agent"])}
    tail_total = int(TOTAL * MIX["tail"])

    n_json = max(0, want["json"] - have["json"])
    plan_agent_layer(plan, world, n_json)
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)

    n_md_sed = max(0, int((want["md"] - have["md"]) * 0.62))
    plan_sediment_volume(plan, world, n_md_sed, sediment)
    have = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)

    targets = {"pdf": max(0, want["pdf"] - have["pdf"]),
               "csv": max(0, want["csv"] - have["csv"]),
               "md": max(0, want["md"] - have["md"]),
               "json": max(0, want["json"] - have["json"])}
    tail_have = sum(have[f] for f in TAIL_FORMATS)
    per_tail = max(0, tail_total - tail_have)
    tw = {"dta": 0.17, "do": 0.17, "R": 0.14, "xlsx": 0.16, "docx": 0.13, "txt": 0.13, "log": 0.10}
    for f, w in tw.items():
        targets[f] = int(per_tail * w)
    plan_filler(plan, world, targets)

    # ---- write the plan and the key --------------------------------------
    KEYS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (KEYS / "skeleton_manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"dirs": dirs, "files": plan.files}, indent=None), encoding="utf-8")
    (KEYS / "placed_catalogue.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({k: v["path"] for k, v in placed_docs.items()}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    key = {
        "built_from_seed": CFG["seed"],
        "ladder": CFG["ladder"],
        "questions": questions,
        "answer_files": {f["path"]: {"role": f["role"], "doc_id": f.get("doc_id"),
                                     "fmt": f["fmt"]}
                         for f in plan.files if f["role"] == "answer"},
        "distractor_files": {d["path"]: d for d in dx},
        "duplicate_clusters": dupes,
        "misnamed_files": misnamed,
        "sediment_anchors": sediment,
        "relationship_links": links,
    }
    (KEYS / "answer_key.json").write_text(json.dumps(key, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")

    fmt_counts = Counter(f["fmt"] for f in plan.files)
    role_counts = Counter(f["role"] for f in plan.files)
    print(f"files planned    : {len(plan.files)}  (target {TOTAL})")
    print(f"by role          : {dict(role_counts)}")
    print(f"by format        : {dict(fmt_counts)}")

def mark_duplicates(plan: Plan, world) -> list[dict]:
    """Turn a share of the filler into scattered copies of other files.

    two thirds are byte-identical; the rest differ by one edit. No copy carries
    a marker saying which one is canonical.
    """
    share = CFG["duplicate_share"]
    pool = [f for f in plan.files if f["role"] == "filler"]
    sources = [f for f in plan.files
               if f["role"] in ("answer", "distractor", "filler", "sediment")
               and f["fmt"] in ("pdf", "csv", "md", "xlsx", "docx", "txt")]
    by_fmt = defaultdict(list)
    for s in sources:
        by_fmt[s["fmt"]].append(s)
    n = int(len(plan.files) * share)
    g0 = W.rng_for("dupvol")
    idx = g0.choice(len(pool), size=min(n, len(pool)), replace=False).tolist()
    clusters = defaultdict(list)
    for k, j in enumerate(idx):
        f = pool[j]
        cands = by_fmt.get(f["fmt"]) or by_fmt["pdf"]
        g = rng("dupvol", k)
        src = cands[int(g.integers(0, len(cands)))]
        if src["path"] == f["path"] or src["dir"] == f["dir"]:
            continue
        identical = bool(g.random() < 0.65)
        newpath = f"{f['dir']}/{src['name']}"
        if newpath in plan.taken:
            continue
        plan.taken.discard(f["path"])
        plan.taken.add(newpath)
        f["path"] = newpath
        f["name"] = src["name"]
        f["role"] = "duplicate"
        f["fmt"] = src["fmt"]
        f["owner"] = src["owner"]
        f["spec"] = {"kind": "duplicate", "source_path": src["path"],
                     "byte_identical": identical,
                     "edit": None if identical else "one_line_changed",
                     "era": f["era"]}
        clusters[src["path"]].append(f["path"])
    return [{"source_path": k, "copies": v,

You are subagent A, Phase 5a of an unattended build. Build `pdf_factory.py` and run it to completion.

FIRST: read `C:\Users\Ali\Desktop\harness\generator\FACTORY_CONTRACT.md` in full. It is the shared contract and it is binding. Your owner name is `pdf`, so your work list is `C:\Users\Ali\Desktop\harness\keys\work\pdf.json` (9234 files) and your log is `C:\Users\Ali\Desktop\harness\logs\pdf_factory.log`.

Write your code at `C:\Users\Ali\Desktop\harness\generator\pdf_factory.py`. Use reportlab.

## What you are producing

Every record in your work list is a PDF. `spec.kind` is one of:

- `"document"` — a real publication from the world catalogue. `spec` gives `doc_type`, `title`, `pub_year`, `fy`, `target_pages`, `fat`, `era`, and `embeds` (a list of `{series_id, vintage_id, chapter, table_ordinal}`, sometimes with `demand_no` or `ministry`).
- `"filler_doc"` — a passive document nobody opened. `spec.filler_kind` says which sort (`journal_article`, `working_paper`, `report`, `lecture_slides`, `old_survey_chapter`, `conference_paper`, `thesis_chapter`, `scanned_note`, plus the fat kinds `statistical_supplement`, `labour_force_survey`, `household_survey_report`, `sbp_annual_report`, `nepra_state_of_industry`, `provincial_adp_book`, `census_report`, `ministry_yearbook`, `agricultural_statistics`, `energy_yearbook`, `trade_statistics`, `budget_in_brief`). Fat ones carry `embeds` too.
- `"series_long"` / other with `spec.misnamed: true` — a short document whose filename lies about its contents; build a normal small table document.

Distractor records (`role: "distractor"`) carry a `spec.variant` naming the mutation and one of these fields, which you MUST honour: `vintage_override` (print that vintage instead), `perturb_pct` (scale every value by that percent), `header_fy_override` (put the wrong fiscal year in the table header while the rows stay the right year's), `watermark` (stamp that text on every page), `base_override`+`rescale`, `unit_override`+`rescale`, `row_label_override`, `scanned: true`.

## Document skeletons (from the build brief -- follow these)

- **Pakistan Economic Survey**: cover; roman-numeral front matter (foreword, contents, list of tables) of 4-8 pages; ~14 chapters (Growth and Investment, Agriculture, Manufacturing and Mining, Fiscal Development, Money and Credit, Capital Markets, Inflation, Trade and Payments, Public Debt, Education, Health and Nutrition, Population/Labour Force, Transport and Communications, Energy); each chapter has prose paragraphs plus 3-8 tables; then a statistical appendix of 40-80 tables.
- **Annual Budget Statement**: receipts, expenditure by demand, summary tables.
- **Demands for Grants**: one dense table block per demand number.
- **Provincial white paper**: budget at a glance, receipts, current expenditure, development programme, debt, social sector.
- **PSDP**: project lists by ministry.
- **Fiscal Operations quarterly**: short, 8-20 pages.
- **IMF staff report / Article IV**: narrative sections plus tables.
- **Working paper / journal article**: abstract, introduction, literature, data, results tables with regression output (coefficients with standard errors in parentheses and significance stars), references.
- **Lecture slides exported to PDF**: one idea per page, large type.
- **Scanned documents** (`spec.scanned` true, or filler_kind `scanned_note`): render each page as an image with PIL (slight rotation, noise, grey speckle) and embed it with NO text layer. These must genuinely have no extractable text.

## Rules that make this a measurement instrument

1. **The PDF page index and the printed page label must differ.** Front matter is roman (i, ii, iii...); chapter pages restart or carry a chapter-offset label like `4-17`. Store both in the sidecar.
2. Tables are real reportlab `Table` objects with a header row, a units row, and footnotes drawn from `Provisional`, `Revised`, `Source: PBS`, `Source: Ministry of Finance`, `P = provisional, R = revised`. Use the vintage's `obs_status` to put P/R markers on the right cells.
3. The same series across years must show the drifting row label, unit switch and rebasing that its vintages specify. Print the vintage the embed names — never the registry values directly.
4. Prose must vary. Build sentences from templates with several alternatives each and fill them from world values, so two survey years do not read identically. Do not emit the same paragraph twice in a document.
5. Vary fonts, margins, leading, table styling and cover design **by era** (`spec.era`): 2011-15 documents should look like LaTeX-era output, 2024-26 ones modern. Use only the base-14 fonts (Helvetica, Times-Roman, Courier and their bold/oblique variants) so nothing depends on a font file.

## Sidecars -- the sub-document ground truth

For EVERY PDF you write (not only fat ones), write `C:\Users\Ali\Desktop\harness\keys\pdf_index\<sha256-of-corpus-relative-path, first 32 hex chars>.json`:

```json
{"path": "<corpus-relative path>", "doc_id": "...", "role": "...", "n_pages": 412,
 "has_text_layer": true,
 "tables": [{"page_index": 187, "page_label": "4-17", "table_title": "Table 4.3: Tax Revenue (FBR + Provincial)",
             "chapter": "Fiscal Development", "table_ordinal": 3,
             "series_id": "tax_revenue", "vintage_id": "tax_revenue::v2", "row_label": "...",
             "unit": "Rs billion", "base_year": "2005-06",
             "rows": {"<row label>": 0}, "cols": {"2019-20": 3},
             "cells": {"2019-20": 4190.0}}]}
```

`page_index` is 0-based within the PDF. `page_label` is what is printed on that page. `table_title` must be the exact string that appears on that page — a later verification step extracts the page text and greps for it, so it must match character for character (avoid characters reportlab renders differently; plain ASCII only). `rows`/`cols` give the position of the series row and each fiscal-year column inside the table.

Getting the exact page index right matters more than anything else here. The reliable way: build the document with a page-counting callback (`onPage` / `canvas.getPageNumber()`) so each table records the page it actually landed on, rather than predicting it. Have your flowable record `canvas.getPageNumber()-1` at draw time. Verify a handful with pypdf after writing and log the result.

## Practicalities

- 1,109,154 pages are planned across 9234 files. Benchmarked at ~4.7 ms/page, that is roughly 87 core-minutes, so about 10 minutes across 12 worker processes. Use `ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=12)`, one task per file, chunked.
- If your own measured throughput projects past 4 hours total, reduce the fat page cap to 500 pages, log that you did, and carry on. Do NOT reduce the number of fat documents.
- Write a progress marker per document and skip completed ones on rerun.
- Log progress every few hundred files so a restart can see where it got to.

Report back: files written, total pages, wall-clock time, mean ms/page, output size on disk, a spot-check confirming three sidecar `page_index`/`table_title` pairs actually resolve via pypdf, confirmation that scanned PDFs have no text layer, and every judgment call you made.

  - `shorten` — keep roughly the first third.
  - `retitle` — change the heading and the opening line to a different but compatible subject.

from pathlib import Path

input.content:
"""ladder.py -- Phase 6.

The top rung is built once. The smaller rungs are derived from it by
subtracting deterministically, never by rebuilding, so a file that survives to
a smaller rung is byte-identical and sits at the identical relative path.

Held at every rung:
  * every answer-bearing file
  * every file named in a question's evidence
  * the anchor copy of every authored document the key cites

Scaled between rungs:
  * filler, scattered duplicates, unreadable files
  * the mutated sediment volume and the bulk of the agent-era layer
  * the distractor set, nested: a question keeps its first k distractors, and
    the set at a smaller rung is a subset of the set at a larger one

Why distractors are nested rather than fixed: the brief asks for 100-150
questions with 10-20 distractors each, which is a floor of about 1,900 files
before a single answer, note or run log is placed. The 500 and 2,000 rungs
cannot hold that and also hold the answers. Nesting keeps every question
answerable with its evidence intact and at least one shadow at every rung,
which is what the rungs are for; the alternative -- emitting a 500 rung with
3,000 files in it -- would make the ladder meaningless. Recorded in the report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "world"))
import world as W  # noqa: E402

CFG = yaml.safe_load((HERE / "config.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
KEYS = ROOT / "keys"
LADDER = CFG["ladder"]
TOP = LADDER[-1]
MIX = CFG["format_mix"]
TAIL_FORMATS = {"dta", "do", "R", "xlsx", "docx", "zip", "txt", "log"}

# distractors kept per question, by rung
DX_PER_RUNG = {500: 1, 2000: 4, 5000: 10, 15000: 10 ** 9}


def bucket(fmt):
    if fmt in ("pdf", "csv", "md"):
        return fmt
    if fmt == "json":
        return "json_agent"
    return "tail"


def load():
    man = json.loads((KEYS / "skeleton_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    key = json.loads((KEYS / "answer_key.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return man, key


def select(files, key, target):
    by_path = {f["path"]: f for f in files}
    protected: set[str] = set()

    for p in key["answer_files"]:
        protected.add(p)
    for q in key["questions"]:
        for ev in q["evidence_addresses"]:
            protected.add(ev["path"])
    for s in key["sediment_anchors"]:
        protected.add(s["path"])
    for m in key["misnamed_files"]:
        protected.add(m["path"])
    for c in key["duplicate_clusters"]:
        for cp in c["copies"]:
            protected.add(cp["path"])
    for lk in key["relationship_links"]:
        for ev in lk["evidence"]:
            protected.add(ev["path"])
    protected = {p for p in protected if p in by_path}

    # nested distractors
    k = DX_PER_RUNG.get(target, 10 ** 9)
    keep_dx: set[str] = set()
    for q in key["questions"]:
        for i, d in enumerate(q["must_not_cite"]):
            if i < k and d["path"] in by_path:
                keep_dx.add(d["path"])
    chosen = set(protected) | keep_dx

    # fill the remainder, preserving the format mix
    remaining = max(0, target - len(chosen))
    pool = [f for f in files if f["path"] not in chosen]
    by_bucket = defaultdict(list)
    for f in pool:
        by_bucket[bucket(f["fmt"])].append(f)
    for b in by_bucket:
        by_bucket[b].sort(key=lambda f: f["path"])

    have = Counter(bucket(by_path[p]["fmt"]) for p in chosen)
    want = {b: int(round(target * MIX[b])) for b in MIX}
    need = {b: max(0, want[b] - have[b]) for b in want}
    scale = remaining / max(1, sum(need.values()))
    take = {b: int(round(n * scale)) for b, n in need.items()}

    g = W.rng_for("ladder", target)
    for b, n in take.items():
        cands = by_bucket.get(b, [])
        if not cands or n <= 0:
            continue
        n = min(n, len(cands))
        idx = g.choice(len(cands), size=n, replace=False).tolist()
        for i in idx:
            chosen.add(cands[i]["path"])

    # top up or trim to hit the target exactly
    leftovers = [f["path"] for f in pool if f["path"] not in chosen]
    leftovers.sort()
    while len(chosen) < target and leftovers:
        chosen.add(leftovers.pop(0))
    if len(chosen) > target:
        droppable = sorted(chosen - protected - keep_dx)
        g2 = W.rng_for("ladder", "trim", target)
        g2.shuffle(droppable)
        while len(chosen) > target and droppable:
            chosen.discard(droppable.pop())
    return chosen, protected, keep_dx


def build_rung(files, key, target, dry=False):
    chosen, protected, keep_dx = select(files, key, target)
    src = ROOT / f"corpus_{TOP}"
    dst = ROOT / f"corpus_{target}"
    by_path = {f["path"]: f for f in files}
    stats = {"target": target, "selected": len(chosen), "protected": len(protected),
             "distractors": len(keep_dx),
             "by_format": dict(Counter(by_path[p]["fmt"] for p in sorted(chosen))),
             "by_role": dict(Counter(by_path[p]["role"] for p in sorted(chosen))),
             "floor_exceeds_target": len(protected) + len(keep_dx) > target}
    if dry:
        return chosen, stats
    copied = skipped = missing = 0
    for p in sorted(chosen):
        s, d = src / p, dst / p
        if not s.exists():
            missing += 1
            continue
        if d.exists() and d.stat().st_size == s.stat().st_size:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        d.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(s, d)
        copied += 1
    # carry the empty directories across too
    dirs = json.loads((KEYS / "work" / "dirs.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for dd in dirs:
        (dst / dd["path"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stats.update(copied=copied, skipped=skipped, missing=missing)
    return chosen, stats


def main(dry=False):
    man, key = load()
    files = man["files"]
    membership, report = {}, []
    for target in LADDER:
        if target == TOP:
            membership[str(target)] = sorted(f["path"] for f in files)
            report.append({"target": target, "selected": len(files), "protected": None,
                           "note": "built directly"})
            continue
        chosen, stats = build_rung(files, key, target, dry=dry)
        membership[str(target)] = sorted(chosen)
        report.append(stats)
        print(f"rung {target:>6}: {stats['selected']} files "
              f"(protected {stats['protected']}, distractors {stats['distractors']}) "
              f"copied={stats.get('copied')} missing={stats.get('missing')}")
    (KEYS / "rung_membership.json").write_text(json.dumps(membership), encoding="utf-8")
    (KEYS / "rung_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(dry="--dry" in sys.argv)

"""timestamps.py -- Phase 7.

One pass over a finished tree, setting atime, mtime and (where Windows lets us)
creation time on every file and folder from the era model.

A tree where everything was modified on the same night is useless, so:
  * each file draws a date inside its era's year range
  * within a project, raw comes before clean comes before output
  * v1 comes before v2; a "superseded" or "old" subfolder is older than its parent
  * the agent-era layer clusters into a run of activity in Feb-Aug 2026
  * a folder's mtime is its newest child's, applied bottom-up after every file

Every assigned time is recorded in keys/mtimes.parquet.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import os
import sys
from ctypes import wintypes
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "world"))
import world as W  # noqa: E402

CFG = yaml.safe_load((HERE / "config.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
KEYS = ROOT / "keys"
ERAS = CFG["eras"]
# Nothing may carry the build date. The window closes at the end of August 2026.
CEILING = datetime(2026, 8, 31, 23, 59, 0)
FLOOR = datetime(2011, 1, 3, 8, 0, 0)

STAGE_RANK = [
    (("/raw", "/raw/", "raw_", "01_data", "rawdata", "raw-data", "/sources", "/source"), 0),
    (("/clean", "/clean/", "/derived", "/intermediate", "/extraction", "02_code"), 1),
    (("/output", "/outputs", "/figures", "/tables", "/results", "04_output"), 2),
]
OLD_MARKERS = ("/superseded", "/old", "/archive", "/attic", "/purana", "/not used",
               "/archived", "/old drives", "/.old_backup")


def _stage(path_lower: str) -> float:
    rank = 1.0
    for markers, r in STAGE_RANK:
        if any(m in path_lower for m in markers):
            rank = float(r)
    return rank


def _version_bump(name_lower: str) -> float:
    for tok, bump in (("v1", 0.0), ("v2", 1.0), ("v3", 2.0), ("_v4", 3.0),
                      ("(2)", 1.0), ("(3)", 2.0), ("final", 1.5), ("revised", 1.8)):
        if tok in name_lower:
            return bump
    return 0.0


def file_time(rec) -> datetime:
    era = rec["era"]
    y0, y1 = ERAS[era]["years"]
    g = W.rng_for("mtime", rec["path"])
    pl = "/" + rec["path"].lower()
    nl = rec["name"].lower()

    if era == "agent":
        # a real burst of recent activity, plus a tail across 2024-2025
        if g.random() < 0.42:
            base = datetime(2026, 2, 1) + timedelta(days=float(g.integers(0, 210)))
        else:
            base = datetime(2024, 1, 15) + timedelta(days=float(g.integers(0, 720)))
    else:
        span_days = (datetime(y1, 12, 20) - datetime(y0, 1, 10)).days
        base = datetime(y0, 1, 10) + timedelta(days=float(g.integers(0, span_days)))

    base += timedelta(days=_stage(pl) * float(g.integers(21, 75)))
    base += timedelta(days=_version_bump(nl) * float(g.integers(9, 40)))
    if any(m in pl for m in OLD_MARKERS):
        base -= timedelta(days=float(g.integers(120, 480)))

    # a working day, working hours, and not the same minute twice
    base = base.replace(hour=int(g.integers(8, 23)), minute=int(g.integers(0, 60)),
                        second=int(g.integers(0, 60)), microsecond=0)
    if base.weekday() == 6 and g.random() < 0.8:
        base -= timedelta(days=1)
    if base > CEILING:
        base = CEILING - timedelta(days=float(g.integers(1, 400)))
    if base < FLOOR:
        base = FLOOR + timedelta(days=float(g.integers(1, 200)))
    return base


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Windows creation time
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
_kernel32 = None
if os.name == "nt":
    try:
        _kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
        _kernel32.CreateFileW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        _kernel32.SetFileTime.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_void_p,
                                          ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
    except Exception:                                        # pragma: no cover
        _kernel32 = None

GENERIC_WRITE = 0x40000000
FILE_SHARE = 0x00000007
OPEN_EXISTING = 3
FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS = 0x02000000
EPOCH_AS_FILETIME = 116444736000000000


class _FILETIME(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("dwLowDateTime", wintypes.DWORD), ("dwHighDateTime", wintypes.DWORD)]


def _ft(dt: datetime) -> _FILETIME:
    ticks = int(dt.timestamp() * 10_000_000) + EPOCH_AS_FILETIME
    return _FILETIME(ticks & 0xFFFFFFFF, ticks >> 32)


def set_creation(path: Path, dt: datetime) -> bool:
    if _kernel32 is None:
        return False
    h = _kernel32.CreateFileW(str(path), GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE, None, OPEN_EXISTING,
                              FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, None)
    if h in (None, -1, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF):
        return False
    try:
        ft = _ft(dt)
        ok = _kernel32.SetFileTime(h, ctypes.byref(ft), ctypes.byref(ft), ctypes.byref(ft))
        return bool(ok)
    finally:
        _kernel32.CloseHandle(h)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def stamp_tree(root: Path, files, members=None):
    by_path = {f["path"]: f for f in files}
    rows, newest = [], {}
    ctime_ok = ctime_fail = 0
    paths = sorted(members) if members is not None else sorted(by_path)
    for rel in paths:
        rec = by_path.get(rel)
        p = root / rel
        if rec is None or not p.exists():
            continue
        dt = file_time(rec)
        ts = dt.timestamp()
        try:
            os.utime(p, (ts, ts))
        except OSError:
            continue
        if set_creation(p, dt):
            ctime_ok += 1
        else:
            ctime_fail += 1
        rows.append({"path": rel, "era": rec["era"], "role": rec["role"], "fmt": rec["fmt"],
                     "mtime_iso": dt.isoformat(), "mtime_epoch": ts})
        cur = p.parent
        while True:
            key = str(cur)
            if newest.get(key, 0) < ts:
                newest[key] = ts
            if cur == root:
                break
            cur = cur.parent

    # folders last, deepest first, so a parent sees its children's final times
    alldirs = sorted((d for d in root.rglob("*") if d.is_dir()),
                     key=lambda d: len(d.parts), reverse=True)
    for d in alldirs:
        ts = newest.get(str(d))
        if ts is None:
            g = W.rng_for("dirtime", str(d.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"))
            dt = FLOOR + timedelta(days=float(g.integers(200, 5300)))
            ts = min(dt, CEILING).timestamp()
        try:
            os.utime(d, (ts, ts))
            set_creation(d, datetime.fromtimestamp(ts))
        except OSError:
            pass
        parent = d.parent
        if newest.get(str(parent), 0) < ts and parent != d:
            newest[str(parent)] = ts
    try:
        os.utime(root, (max(newest.values()), max(newest.values())))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    return rows, ctime_ok, ctime_fail


def main():
    man = json.loads((KEYS / "skeleton_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    files = man["files"]
    membership = json.loads((KEYS / "rung_membership.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    allrows = []
    for rung in CFG["ladder"]:
        root = ROOT / f"corpus_{rung}"
        if not root.exists():
            print(f"corpus_{rung}: not present, skipped")
            continue
        rows, ok, fail = stamp_tree(root, files, membership.get(str(rung)))
        for r in rows:
            r["rung"] = rung
        allrows += rows
        print(f"corpus_{rung}: {len(rows)} files stamped, creation-time set on {ok}, "
              f"unavailable on {fail}")
    try:
        import pandas as pd
        pd.DataFrame(allrows).to_parquet(KEYS / "mtimes.parquet", index=False)
        print(f"wrote keys/mtimes.parquet ({len(allrows)} rows)")
    except Exception as exc:
        (KEYS / "mtimes.json").write_text(json.dumps(allrows), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"parquet unavailable ({exc}); wrote keys/mtimes.json instead")

    from collections import Counter
    top = [r for r in allrows if r["rung"] == CFG["ladder"][-1]]
    hist = Counter(r["mtime_iso"][:4] for r in top)
    print("year histogram (top rung):", dict(sorted(hist.items())))
    print("era shares:", {k: round(v / max(1, len(top)), 3)
                          for k, v in Counter(r["era"] for r in top).items()})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    for f in first(lambda f: f["depth"] == 1 and f["fmt"] in ("md", "csv", "pdf")):

                       "layout that was never completed.")
    for f in first(lambda f: f["fmt"] == "xlsx"):
        add(f["path"], "A spreadsheet with multiple sheets and a merged title block: text "

    print(f"wrote keys/canary_slots.json with {len(slots)} slots")

        print(f"  [{s['format']:5s} d{s['depth']} {s['era']:8s}] {s['path']}{pg}")
